gates.title: The agent creates freely. Five checks protect the result.
gates.description: A gate is just a test the page must pass before launch. It does not make design decisions for the agent. It catches the expensive, embarrassing failures that a confident-looking preview can hide.

items.label: 01 / OFFER
items.question: Does a stranger understand what this is?
items.description: Checks that the headline, audience, deliverable, price, CTA, qualification, and guarantee tell one coherent story.
items.catches: Vague promises, mismatched prices, missing deliverables, and copy that sounds polished but says nothing.

items.label: 02 / SCREEN
items.question: Does it still look good on a phone?
items.description: Opens the real built page at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes and checks overflow, visible actions, fonts, spacing, and screenshots.
items.catches: Tiny text, cut-off sections, hidden buttons, awkward wrapping, and payment boxes crushed against the edge.

items.label: 03 / ACCESS
items.question: Can every buyer actually use it?
items.description: Runs accessibility checks for readable contrast, meaningful structure, keyboard focus, and a checkout action that can be activated.
items.catches: Low-contrast copy, invisible focus, broken headings, and buttons that only work with a mouse.

items.label: 04 / MONEY
items.question: Does the purchase path agree end to end?
items.description: Validates product keys, prices, bump selection, upsell order, webhook signing, status, and delivery configuration.
items.catches: Wrong totals, dead checkout sessions, duplicate fulfillment, missing products, and buyers paying without access.

items.label: 05 / RELEASE
items.question: Is this exact version the one going live?
items.description: Compares the built files, browser receipt, screenshots, Git commit, and Cloudflare deployment before reporting success.
items.catches: Stale previews, uncommitted edits, deploying the wrong build, and ‘it worked on my machine’ claims.

faqs.question: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.answer: No. The intended workflow is to open a capable coding agent and say, ‘Help me launch my offer.’ The agent handles Git, files, commands, builds, and deployment. You provide the offer details, accounts, and approvals.

faqs.question: Can I change the copy myself?
faqs.answer: Yes. Run the included editor through your agent, open the local Keystatic screen, choose the page, and edit normal labeled fields. You can change headlines, prices, benefits, proof, FAQs, checkout copy, bump copy, upsells, and site settings without touching source code.

faqs.question: Is this really a replacement for GoHighLevel?
faqs.answer: It replaces the landing-page and paid-funnel part for owners who want pages, checkout, bumps, upsells, delivery, and publishing under their control. It is not pretending to replace a full CRM, phone, SMS, calendar, and automation suite.

faqs.question: What accounts do I need?
faqs.answer: You need GitHub for safe source backup, Cloudflare for hosting and the small D1 database, Dodo Payments for checkout, Resend for access email, and a coding agent that can work with a repository. Your agent walks you through each connection.

faqs.question: Does it include order bumps and upsells?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every funnel can include one clear order bump during the email-to-checkout step and up to two polished post-purchase upsell pages. The product records, status, customer decisions, and delivery emails share one funnel configuration.

faqs.question: Can I use Stripe instead of Dodo?
faqs.answer: The payment layer is intentionally contained and can be replaced by a capable developer or agent. Dodo is the supported out-of-the-box path today because inline checkout, product setup, and the post-purchase flow are already implemented. Stripe parity is not included yet.

faqs.question: Will every page look the same?
faqs.answer: No. The repository provides good typography, spacing, contrast, buttons, cards, checkout patterns, and verification. The agent can compose, remove, or redesign sections around the offer. The constraints protect clarity and reliability, not one universal block order.

faqs.question: Are there still ongoing costs?
faqs.answer: There is no required monthly fee for this builder itself. Your payment processor, email provider, domain, hosting, AI agent, or other services may charge their own account or usage fees. Those accounts remain yours.

finalTitle: Your next funnel should be an asset—not another subscription.
